summary.text: Matt Bunch is a Republican state representative from Oregon House District 51 who was appointed to the seat in November 2025 and is seeking election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He has worked in the insurance industry and chairs the Clackamas County Fair board.

paragraphs.text: On his legislative website, Matt Bunch says he was raised in Eastern Oregon and attended Oregon State University, and that his career ranged from Ford Motor Credit to roles in the insurance industry.
He also says he has been a development officer for the Oregon FFA Foundation and a bus driver for the Oregon City School District.
He lists membership in the St. Patrick Knights of Columbus, Canby High School Boosters and the Clackamas County Farm Bureau, and says he is married and has three grown children.
Bunch earned a bachelor's degree from Oregon State University, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working in the insurance industry.
He was appointed to Oregon House District 51 on November 17, 2025, to replace Christine Drazan.
On his legislative website, he says he represents Canby, Estacada, Sandy and unincorporated Clackamas County.
